name: docs-site
description: /docs-site:init sets up a repo's docs site in one script run: a mkdocs.yml with no nav list and the site's own port, a docs home page and site/ in .gitignore, so `uvx zensical serve` shows the Markdown in docs/ with a sidebar, sections and search. Each repo gets its own port, so any number of sites can run at once, and a second run changes nothing.
